scripts.build:single: vite build --mode single && cp dist-single/index.html LearnPath-ML.html
scripts.verify:stats: esbuild scripts/verify-stats.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=scripts/.verify.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.verify.cjs | python scripts/verify_stats.py
scripts.verify:snippets: esbuild scripts/dump-snippets.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=scripts/.snippets.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.snippets.cjs | python scripts/verify_snippets.py
scripts.schemas: for t in LessonFile:lesson DeepLesson:chapter QuizBank:quiz Project:project; do ts-json-schema-generator --path src/content/types.ts --type ${t%%:*} --no-type-check -o content/schema/${t##*:}.schema.json; done
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run validate && npm run build
